info.name: Transaction Ledger API
info.description: Run ALL folders in order, one iteration at a time. Creates two fresh accounts per run and leaves permanent ledger records. Use only a test deployment/database. Set base_url to localhost or your Render service URL without a trailing slash. Expected final balances: A=50.00, B=70.00. Run within the 100 requests/minute limit; repeated runs may require waiting one minute.
